subject: RM_Sapblister
departures: body is one swollen, globular mass, puffed up like a bloated sac rather than a ribbed column or sphere
the skin is covered in raised blisters instead of the even ribs and spine rows a cactus has
red sap weeps from the blisters, showing as glossy beads, runs and streaks down the skin
the red sap is thick and visibly viscous, pooling or crusting where it has run instead of dripping thin
